subject: Intro phone screen — 20 min availability & quick prep
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Elara Syme <elara.syme@gmail.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Intro phone screen — 20 min availability & quick prep

Hi Elara —

Thanks for your interest in the SDE role at Redwood. Would love to set up a quick 20‑minute intro phone screen so we can learn more about your recent systems work and share context about the role. I copied Markus (hiring manager) so he’s aware of the timing but not required for this call unless you prefer it.

A few windows that work on our side (I included UTC conversions):
- Wed Oct 7, 09:00–09:20 PDT / 16:00–16:20 UTC
- Thu Oct 8, 12:00–12:20 PDT / 19:00–19:20 UTC
- Fri Oct 9, 17:30–17:50 PDT / 00:30–00:50 UTC (Sat 00:30 your local time)

If none of those fit, please reply with 2–3 times in your local timezone and I’ll do my best to match.

Prep notes:
- 20 minutes total: quick background, a brief technical question (system design tradeoffs at high level), and time for your questions.
- Interviewer: Markus Klein (Staff SWE) — focus will be on architecture thinking, not whiteboard-level coding.
- Attached is a short role one‑pager and I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once we lock a time.

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Senior Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
Rachel.Kim@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555‑0142
Redwood_SDE-1pager.pdf (attached)

From: Elara Syme <elara.syme@gmail.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 20:07:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Intro phone screen — 20 min availability & quick prep

Hi Rachel —

Thanks — happy to take a slot. I’m based in Dublin (UTC+1). The options above look doable if we pick the Thu or Fri slot in UTC. My availability (local times) next week:
- Thu Oct 8: 20:00–21:30 (local)
- Fri Oct 9: 01:30–02:00 (local) — ok if later works for you
- Fri Oct 9: 10:00–11:00 (local)

I’d prefer Thu evening (20:00 local) if Markus can make it; otherwise the earlier Fri morning is fine.

Quick Q — could you confirm who will be on the call and whether you prefer I bring an example system I worked on?

Best,
Elara
elara.syme@gmail.com
LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/elarasyme

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Intro phone screen — 20 min availability & quick prep

Hi Elara —

Great, thanks for the detail. Let’s lock Thu Oct 8 at 19:00 UTC (that’s 20:00 Dublin / 12:00 PDT). I’ll send a calendar invite (calendar-invite-elara.ics attached) and include a short agenda.

Agenda (20m):
- 3m: intros and role context (me)
- 12m: technical discussion — high level system tradeoffs (Markus)
- 5m: your questions + next steps

Markus will join but if anything changes I’ll let you know. No formal slides needed — bringing one short example system (a single slide or bullet points) is helpful but not required.

Attached: Redwood_SDE-1pager.pdf, calendar-invite-elara.ics

Looking forward to speaking on Thu —
Rachel
Senior Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
P: +1 (415) 555‑0142
